# Getting Started

Base URL: `https://api.minubo.com`

This reference combines multiple service specifications into one API view, including Auth, ETL, and the Data API.

## Requirements

To use the minubo API, you need to have a valid token ID and token secret. Those can be obtained from the minubo Application by navigating to [Settings -> API Credentials](https://app.minubo.com/#/settings/tenant/apicredentials).
## Authentication

Create a JWT using `POST /auth/v1/token`:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.minubo.com/auth/v1/token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tokenId":"<token-id>","tokenSecret":"<token-secret>"}'
```

Use the returned token as a bearer token for protected endpoints.

## Examples

### Trigger ETL and check status

```python
import requests

base = "https://api.minubo.com"

# Get valid token
token = requests.post(
    f"{base}/auth/v1/token",
    json={"tokenId": "<token-id>", "tokenSecret": "<token-secret>"},
).json()["token"]

headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

# Trigger ETL process
process_uuid = requests.post(
    f"{base}/etl/v1/process/start",
    headers=headers,
).json()["processUuid"]

# Check status
status = requests.get(
    f"{base}/etl/v1/process/status/{process_uuid}",
    headers=headers,
).json()
print(status)
```

### Inspect schema and run a data query

```python
import requests

base = "https://api.minubo.com"

# Get valid token
token = requests.post(
    f"{base}/auth/v1/token",
    json={"tokenId": "<token-id>", "tokenSecret": "<token-secret>"},
).json()["token"]

headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

schema = requests.get(
    f"{base}/data/v1/schema",
    headers=headers,
).json()

print(schema["attributes"][0])

result = requests.post(
    f"{base}/data/v1/query",
    headers={**headers, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={
        "attributes": ["prdNumber"],
        "measures": ["omsOrdNum"],
        "timeFilter": {
            "from": "2026-01-01",
            "to": "2026-01-31"
        },
        "limit": 1000
    },
).json()

print(result)
```

### Troubleshooting

- `401 Unauthorized`: generate a new token and update the bearer header.
- `429 Too Many Requests`: Data API endpoints are rate-limited to 50 requests per 10 minutes per API token.
